# ChronoMind AI — backend requirements
#
# Generated by scanning actual imports across backend/**/*.py, not copied
# from a template. Versions are minimums (>=), not exact pins, based on
# what's confirmed working — loose pins avoid unnecessary conflicts on a
# fresh machine while still documenting what's actually required.
#
# Install with:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt

# --- Web framework ---
fastapi>=0.140.0
uvicorn[standard]>=0.51.0
python-multipart>=0.0.32   # required by FastAPI for File()/Form() uploads in /chat, /ingest, /propose

# --- Data validation ---
pydantic>=2.13.0

# --- LLM / reasoning pipeline (Gemini via LangChain) ---
langchain-core>=1.5.0
langchain-google-genai>=4.3.0
google-genai>=2.14.0        # imported directly in main.py for genai_errors.APIError handling

# --- Networking / resilience ---
httpx>=0.28.0               # imported directly in main.py/ocr.py for httpx.TransportError handling
tenacity>=9.1.0             # retry/backoff wrapper around Gemini calls in ingestion/ocr.py

# --- Image handling (OCR via Gemini vision) ---
pillow>=12.1.0              # resizes/compresses images before sending to Gemini in ingestion/ocr.py

# --- Date parsing ---
python-dateutil>=2.9.0      # resolves free-form deadline strings in background_manager/monitor.py and proposal_manager/builder.py

# --- NOT required, despite appearing in the repo ---
